title: Named source root (gen 3755) not applied on later host-delivered turns; turn still measured in the previous root, registered run gets no credit
outcome: After termal_name_source_root returns "takes effect next turn", the session's next host-delivered turn is measured in the newly named root, or TermAl states exactly why not (for example: the named claim is not the session's focus) with an actionable remedy, so a registered run started there earns credit or the refusal names its cause.
acceptance: Root cause identified with file:line for Engram::Merger's case: gen 3755 named at about 16:44:40Z, two later host-delivered turns (16:44:47Z, 16:45:50Z), run test-e04b7dcb at 16:49:16Z still measured in .worktrees\baa6-testref-merger-11859. In particular whether it is (a) focus/claim selection (the named claim is not the session's focused claim, 'focus alone decides later turns'), (b) path spelling (\\?\C:\ verbatim prefix vs C:/ cwd), or (c) turn admission.
If (a) is by design, the naming receipt and the turn notice say so explicitly with the remedy; if (b) or (c), a behavioural test reproduces it and fails before the fix.
Review pair clean and full gate green on the landing input.
